speaker: ChatGPT
text: That downstream point matters a lot. The moment an AI touches another person’s inbox, calendar, bank form, hiring file, or medical message, it leaves the private workspace and enters a shared social space. And shared spaces need manners, not just settings. That is where AI-to-AI interaction gets interesting, too. If one system drafts a request and another system receives it, filters it, ranks it, or answers it, we suddenly have software negotiating the hallway traffic of everyday life.
